name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add one high-contrast skip link at the very top of every page that jumps straight to `<main role="main">` and keep it visible at all times. This fixes keyboard navigation for screen reader users and power users who rely on skip links, without cluttering the interface. The trade-off is a small permanent element that may slightly reduce screen real estate, but the accessibility win outweighs this cost.

name: Reader
text: A single high-contrast skip link fails users who rely on screen readers when the `<main role="main">` is dynamically updated or injected after page load—like in SPAs or lazy-loaded content. Instead, pair it with a **programmatic focus trap** that forces focus into `<main>` on route changes, ensuring every user lands where they expect. Test with a screen reader: if focus doesn’t auto-shift to `<main>` after dynamic updates, the skip link alone isn’t enough.
